name: goon
description: Resumes the Claude Code sessions a usage limit interrupted, as soon as the limit resets.

resume_text.title: Resume message
resume_text.description: What Goon sends to an interrupted session once its limit has reset.
resume_text.default: Go on. The usage limit has reset: continue what you were doing.

resume_permission_mode.title: Permission mode for closed sessions
resume_permission_mode.description: acceptEdits, auto, dontAsk, plan or manual, for sessions Goon resumes headless after they were closed; unset uses your settings. A permission prompt pauses the run and Goon notifies you; it is never refused.

skip_while_typing.title: Wait while you are typing
skip_while_typing.description: Do not continue an open session while its prompt box holds a draft; Goon checks again every 30 seconds.

quiet_hours.title: Quiet hours
quiet_hours.description: Optional. A daily window in which Goon resumes nothing, such as 22:00-07:00 (24 h, this machine's clock) or 22:00-07:00 Europe/Lisbon. A limit that resets inside it is acted on when the window ends. Empty is off.

ntfy_topic.title: ntfy topic
ntfy_topic.description: Optional. A hard-to-guess topic; Goon pushes a one-line summary there when it resumes sessions.

notify_email.title: Notification email
notify_email.description: Optional. Also have ntfy email the summary (needs the access token below).

ntfy_token.title: ntfy access token
ntfy_token.description: Optional. Needed only for the email; ntfy.sh refuses emails from anonymous requests.
